name: Undertaking Amount
definition: Amount of an undertaking such as a guarantee or standby letter of credit.

BalanceAmount.name: Balance Amount
BalanceAmount.definition: Calculated undertaking available balance amount resulting from the application of the variation amount.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Qualification of the costs and other amounts covered by the amount of the undertaking.

Undertaking.name: Undertaking
Undertaking.definition: Undertaking for which an amount is specified.

Tolerance.name: Tolerance
Tolerance.definition: Percentage (original or updated in case of amendment) by which the amount claimed under the undertaking may vary.

Interest.name: Interest
Interest.definition: Interest associated with the undertaking amount.
